root_extension.what: aorta centerline extended to the bottom of the aortic root
root_extension.method: path through the lumen minimising the integral of 1/R^2 (R = distance to the wall), smoothed and resampled; radius = exact distance to the wall

lumen_wall.what: radii measured to the phantom model's own inner wall; points as phantom_arch_all.json except the aortic root, re-routed on this wall
lumen_wall.radius: exact distance to the wall, at least 0.3 mm
